name: @bernouy/auth-core
description: CMS-owned authentication primitives (LocalAuth + OidcAuth + PAT + signed cookies) plus the membership / identity-provider / credential stores. Provider-agnostic — Keycloak/Google/Okta plug in as one OIDC backend among many. Consumed by `@bernouy/cms`, the hub composition root, and any other surface that needs an admin-side auth chain.
